context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 77 validated 3 new features: (1) SMTP Provider - PUT /api/admin/email-config accepts smtp block {host, port, username, password, use_tls, use_starttls, from_name, from_email} + fallback_to_smtp flag, GET returns masked password. Provider select has 4 options: none, resend, sendgrid, smtp. (2) DNS Check - GET /api/admin/email-config/dns-check?domain=example.com&provider=resend returns {domain, mx, spf, dkim, dmarc, severity, summary, hints}. Each record has {ok:bool, records:[]}. Falls back to stored sender_email domain if no params. (3) Force-Logout - POST /api/admin/users/{user_id}/force-logout bumps token_version by 1, old tokens return 401 'Session invalidated'. POST /api/admin/force-logout-all increments token_version for ALL users except caller. Token version encoded as 'tv' claim in JWT, validated on every authenticated request and refresh. Regression: All auth + admin flows from iteration 75/76 still work.
